name: branding-black-grotesk-type-scale-spec-page
title: Overused Grotesk Type Specimen on Black
whatItIs: A black page with a giant white 'Overused' above a dark grey 'Grotesk' fading away, then rows for heading, title and body samples with labels and sizes separated by hairlines.
whatItMeans: The huge specimen makes the typeface the hero, and the fading second word adds depth.
techniques: Second line at very low contrast
Small caps role labels with right-aligned sizes
Only white and grey on black

vocabulary.definition: A large display of a typeface.
A small caption naming a text role like heading or body.
A line set at very low contrast to recede.
